# awsappstream_stack_theme (Resource)

Manages a custom branding theme for an AppStream stack. A stack theme customizes the appearance of the streaming application catalog page, including colors, title text, footer links, and branding assets such as logos and favicons.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# minimal stack theme
resource "awsappstream_stack_theme" "example" {
  stack_name    = "example-stack"
  title_text    = "Example AppStream"
  theme_styling = "BLUE"

  organization_logo_s3_location {
    s3_bucket = "my-appstream-assets"
    s3_key    = "branding/logo.png"
  }

  favicon_s3_location {
    s3_bucket = "my-appstream-assets"
    s3_key    = "branding/favicon.ico"
  }
}
```

```terraform
# full stack theme
resource "awsappstream_stack_theme" "example" {
  stack_name    = "example-stack"
  title_text    = "Example AppStream Portal"
  theme_styling = "LIGHT_BLUE"

  organization_logo_s3_location {
    s3_bucket = "my-appstream-assets"
    s3_key    = "branding/logo.png"
  }

  favicon_s3_location {
    s3_bucket = "my-appstream-assets"
    s3_key    = "branding/favicon.ico"
  }

  footer_links = [
    {
      display_name    = "IT Support"
      footer_link_url = "https://support.example.com"
    },
    {
      display_name    = "Documentation"
      footer_link_url = "https://docs.example.com/appstream"
    },
    {
      display_name    = "Privacy Policy"
      footer_link_url = "https://example.com/privacy"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `favicon_s3_location` (Attributes) Specifies the Amazon S3 location of the favicon displayed in browser tabs during application streaming sessions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--favicon_s3_location))
- `organization_logo_s3_location` (Attributes) Specifies the Amazon S3 location of the organization logo displayed in the header of the streaming application catalog page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organization_logo_s3_location))
- `stack_name` (String) The name of the AppStream stack that the theme is applied to. Changing this value forces the theme to be replaced.
- `theme_styling` (String) The color theme applied to links, text, buttons, and accents in the streaming catalog page.
- `title_text` (String) The title displayed at the top of the browser tab during application streaming sessions.

### Optional

- `footer_links` (Attributes Set) Optional links displayed in the footer of the streaming application catalog page, such as support, documentation, or marketing links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--footer_links))

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The timestamp when the stack theme was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) A synthetic identifier for the stack theme, equal to the stack name. This value is managed by the provider and cannot be set manually.
- `state` (String) The current state of the AppStream stack theme.
- `theme_favicon_url` (String) The URL of the icon that is displayed at the top of the browser tab during application streaming sessions.
- `theme_organization_logo_url` (String) The URL of the logo that is displayed in the header of the streaming application catalog page.

<a id="nestedatt--favicon_s3_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `favicon_s3_location`

Required:

- `s3_bucket` (String) The name of the Amazon S3 bucket.

Optional:

- `s3_key` (String) The S3 object key of the favicon.


<a id="nestedatt--organization_logo_s3_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organization_logo_s3_location`

Required:

- `s3_bucket` (String) The name of the Amazon S3 bucket.

Optional:

- `s3_key` (String) The S3 object key of the organization logo.


<a id="nestedatt--footer_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `footer_links`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) The name displayed for the footer link in the catalog page.
- `footer_link_url` (String) The URL that the footer link points to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import awsappstream_stack_theme.example "example-stack-name"
```
